The author announced the proof in a four-page note
The second half looks for the note's terms in the names, and README.md defines the vocabulary
The figures come from the source after the merge of 2026-11-22, read as text without running Lean
A published statement is a parameterless Prop definition in one of five namespaces, and it states a result without proving it
350 of the 361 lie in Published, four in Hypotheses₂, three in Lit, two in Pub, two in LiteratureTheorems
Claim, end of a claim and premises of a theorem are read from its statement text at the first colon and the last arrow
A theorem proves a published statement when it has no premises and its claim is that statement
A theorem derives a published statement when its claim ends in it and the theorem has premises
A theorem takes a published statement when the statement stands among its premises
Proves, derives and takes are the roles, and the marks of a skeleton declaration are its roles
published.py lists the statements, takes the theorems naming each from the declaration graph and finds the role by the last part of the name
Of 361 published statements 350 are in Published, 292 reached, 206 proved, 60 only derived, 26 neither

nodes.title: Five things can be read from the table
Sixteen of the 20 terms have matches, and Stepanov, Vandiver, Behrend and Iwasawa tower have none
Seesaw, Bessel period, Gan-Gross-Prasad, Siegel mass and Chowla-Selberg lie 74 to 94 % below B, which gathers 35 % of everything
Divisibility of the lift, Bost slope, von Mangoldt sum and explicit formula lie 69 to 83 % in A outside B, which gathers 31.5 %
96 % of the trace formula matches and 73 % of GradedWeylDivisibility lie in Else, which holds 19 %
Theta lifts, Rallis and covolumes are spread more widely, and definite unitary groups lie mostly in Else and B
26,784 declarations carry the word Iwasawa, 24,882 of them through IwasawaDecomposition, and the other 1,902 were not examined
The writer reads UpperTheory.Top.VWin as the note's weakening of Vandiver, on resemblance alone
VVle bounds a sum over primes l and exponents e of lengths shaLen from Galois cohomology, and the note's entry speaks of classes indexed by ℓ and e
VWin is built from VVle, is a premise of every_character_of_literature_of_vWin and is the end of vwin_of_row, which gathers 55,754
A literature result that the code states outside the five namespaces is not counted
The writer reads three premises of topCovolSlim2_use_alt_alt as literature results, by their names, and they lie in none of the five namespaces
If each of the 361 is a literature result, 361 is a lower limit for the literature results the code states
A skeleton declaration without a mark can still restate a known result
Reading roles from text miscounts a claim that ends in a quantifier or a conjunction, which can move items into the row of 26 or the row without a mark
A match shows where the code uses a word and not that the mathematics is the step the note means
The writer chose the patterns, which stand in TERMS in published.py
A term without a match can mean a missing ingredient or another name for it
The timeline that names Iwasawa tower, Vandiver and Behrend is partly a paraphrase by the author's own account
